title: Lesson 1: How to Hold the Keyboard
intro: Before you start Keyboard Village, take a minute to set up your hands correctly. Good habits now make everything after this faster and easier.
tip1: Sit up straight with your wrists resting lightly above the keyboard, not pressing down on the desk.
tip2: Find the two small bumps on the F and J keys — that's how you find home row without looking.
tip3: Rest your left fingers on A, S, D, F and your right fingers on J, K, L, ; — thumbs stay on the space bar.
tip4: Each finger is responsible for the keys directly above, below, and next to it. Try not to reach across with the wrong finger.
tip5: Keep your eyes on the screen, not your hands — your fingers will learn the positions with practice.
closing: Ready? Start with Find the Key below to practice pressing keys one at a time.
